content: User transcriptions show loops of two or four chords. Each chord has added notes.
parameters: Drunk (F minor): V7(#9) to VI7, that is C7#9 to D-flat 7. Threshold chorus (A-flat major): I(add6, add9) to vi7(add11). Bird on the Wing chorus (A minor): VI7, VII(add6, add9), i9, VII6(add9)
where: Drunk; Threshold; Bird on the Wing

content: The Hooktheory metrics rate the chords as very complex and very unusual, and the melodies as simple.
parameters: Scale 0 to 100; 50 = average song. Chord complexity: 94, 85, 87. Chord progression novelty: 69, 100, 98. Melodic complexity: 30, 42, 6. Chord-melody tension: 75, 75, 25 (Drunk, Threshold, Bird on the Wing)
where: Drunk; Threshold; Bird on the Wing

content: Minor is a little more frequent than major. Tonics on the flat side are frequent.
parameters: SongBPM (algorithmic): 16 minor, 13 major. Tonics: G (5 tracks), B (4), F (4), D-flat (4), A (3), A-flat (3), B-flat (2), E, F-sharp, C, D (1 each). 13 of 29 tonics are F, B-flat, A-flat or D-flat. For Drunk the tools do not agree (G major; F minor)
where: All four releases (computed from the database values)

item: Pedal notes under chords with no function
content: Neely's advice when chords do not relate by function: hold two notes as a pedal under the changing chords. He hears root motion by a fifth as stronger than root motion by a third.
parameters: Example: E and B held under Cmaj7, E7, G6, F-sharp 7sus4

content: Melodies made from perfect fourths are a habit of Neely: the theme music of his lesson videos is 'perfect fourth-based jazz melodies' with autotune. The high-C bass tuning (all strings a fourth apart) is for melodies, fourth chords and other chords.
parameters: Interval of 5 semitones. Tuning E-A-D-G-C

item: Extreme reharmonisation of a pop song
content: The cover Want to Want Me gives a pop song many more chords than usual. Neely made a lesson from it with the title 'Extreme jazz fusion reharmonization'. In the same lesson he recommends a cover by the band Knower.
parameters: Cover released 2017-01-30; lesson video 2017-02-04. The source gives no count of chords

item: Plain diatonic loops are also present
content: Not all harmony is dense. A chord detector reads Ether as a loop of plain triads. The Dark is called pop-like. A review hears pop, soul and R&B in the 2021 album.
parameters: Ether (algorithmic): G, D, Em, A, Bm

content: No Sungazer track with a stated microtonal tuning was found. Outside the band Neely made lo-fi pieces in equal divisions of the octave other than 12.
parameters: 24, 19 and 17 equal divisions of the octave (video of 2019-12-23)

content: E minor: i sus4 - VI (add 6, add 9) - VII - iv7 - flat II (the transcription writes the last chord as flat II in relation to i).
parameters: 5 chords in the loop. 1 sus chord; 1 chord with added 6th and 9th; the last chord is a flat II. A machine gives A minor

item: What About Me?: chords of the chorus
content: E Dorian: i7 - vi half-diminished (first inversion) - i7 - IV - i (add 9).
parameters: 5 chords in the loop; the tonic chord comes 3 times. A machine gives B minor

content: B-flat major. Intro: V sus2 - vi sus2 - V sus2 - I sus2 - vi sus2. Chorus: IV sus2 - flat II 7 - I7 - vi (add 9) - flat VI 7. A second analysis gives the main cycle as B-flat maj7 (add 2) - G m7 - G-flat maj7 (add 2) - D-flat (add 2) - E-flat maj7 (add 2).
parameters: Sus2 or add 9 on 7 of the 10 chords of the first analysis. Chromatic chords: flat II 7, flat VI 7, flat VI maj7, flat III. Root motion by semitone: G to G-flat

item: Xavi and Outlier: chords of the chorus
content: Xavi, A Dorian: ii half-diminished (sus4, second inversion) - III7 - VII9 - I9. Outlier, C Mixolydian: I - flat III (add 9) - II - flat VI 7 - flat II 7.
parameters: Xavi: dominant chords on III, VII, and I. Outlier: 3 of the 5 chords are not in the mode

content: Chord complexity: Lingus 70; Thing of Gold 76; What About Me? 86; Xavi 93; Outlier 96. Melodic complexity: What About Me? 57; Lingus 60; Thing of Gold 66; Xavi 95; Outlier 97. Score for a new chord progression: 73 to 99.
parameters: Scale 0 to 100; 50 = the average song of the database. Tension between chords and melody: 43 to 92

content: Each transcribed section is a loop of 4 or 5 chords. Modes: Dorian 2; minor 1; major 1; Mixolydian 1. A flat II chord is in 3 of the 5 tracks. 4 of the 5 loops have a chord that is not in the mode.
parameters: Derived from the 5 transcriptions
where: Lingus; What About Me?; Thing of Gold; Xavi; Outlier

content: What About Me?: the music goes to a new key at the place where the listener expects the riff. Thing of Gold: the cycle returns in different keys. League in his solo songs: the key changes between verse and chorus, and the music does not land on the new tonic for a few bars.
parameters: Models that League names for the key change between verse and chorus: Hall & Oates, Peter Gabriel
where: We Like It Here; groundUP; So Many Me (2021)

item: Chord vocabulary and gospel moves (standard knowledge)
content: Chords have 9ths, 11ths, and 13ths; sus and add2 chords; slash chords; voicings in fourths on the keyboards. Solo sections are vamps of 1 to 4 chords. Gospel moves from the Dallas church players: chromatic passing chords, IV over V, fast turnarounds, organ swells, and a 'shout' section at the end.
parameters: Vamp length 1, 2, or 4 bars (estimate). Pedal points under chords that change (estimate)

content: Minor seventh chords with an added 11th. The roots go down by step.
parameters: i7(add11), VII11, #vi7(add11), VI13, v7(add11) in F-sharp minor. Chord complexity 99 of 100; progression novelty 98

content: A mode with borrowed flat-side chords; added ninths.
parameters: The Government Knows (G Mixolydian): v11, vi7, ii7, bIII7, bVI7. It's All Nothing Until It's Everything (E-flat major): I(add9), vi11, IV9, V6/5(add11); bridge I(add9), bII9, ii7(add13), bIII, I6. Chord complexity 96 to 97

content: Sixth, add9, sus and 11th chords on simple roots.
parameters: Things: i7, IVsus2sus4, VII6(add9), v7, IV6. Let It Happen: I, IV6(add9), bVII6(add9), I6, V7(#5 b9) of vi. Chord complexity (0 to 100): Blimp 100; Ghost Story 98; It's So Easy 97; Let It Happen 92; Things 90

content: The roots go up by half steps with no function, then fall a third.
parameters: Chorus: A-7, Bb, B-7, C(add9), then down a minor third to A-7. Chord types named: Maj13(#11), Maj9, add9, minor 11, slash chords

content: Chords overlap like a hazy organ, often with strings.
parameters: The analyst calls this a Louis Cole signature. Cole takes harmony from jazz (Gil Evans, Miles Davis) and writes at the keyboard

content: Sus chords, added sixths and ninths, and inversions at high speed.
parameters: V7sus4(no5), vi4/2, bVI(add6 add9), V4/2 of IV, IV7sus2 in D major. Chord complexity 98; novelty 98. The review: "rapid-fire harmonic changes"

content: Melody and chords are made in turn by the two members.
parameters: He sings notes and she writes chords around them; or she has a melody and he adds drums. She writes in notation software, then moves MIDI to Ableton

content: Minor iv9 and i9 chords are the basic colour.
parameters: Body Language (G minor): iv9, i9, III6/4, v7; chorus i9, ii7, #vi7. Pancake Feet (C-sharp minor): iv9, v7, i7, v7, VI9. Chord complexity 95 to 98

content: Chords with seconds inside, in the middle register.
parameters: 4 to 6 notes in one octave; one or two seconds inside; top note from C4 to C6; bass alone below C3. Types: major 7 sharp 11, minor 11, major 9, sus with add9, 13. One chord for 2 or 4 beats (estimate)

content: No functional harmony. A central pitch on the lowest string, with semitone neighbours. Riffs are single lines; chords are rare, because with power chords on the eighth string the sound 'just turns to mush'. The band names tritones, minor and diminished scales and says that it mostly avoids major keys.
parameters: 'Stengah': centre F#; riff I uses only F, Gb, G, Ab; largest chord a fifth with a flat ninth; riffs shift by a half step. 'Lethargica': tritone power chords under the voice. Solo scale in 'Stengah': F Mixolydian with flat 6 (fifth mode of Bb melodic minor)

item: Key centres tied to the lowest string
content: The open lowest string or its first frets give the key centre of the heavy sections.
parameters: F and F# (Meshuggah; lowest string F or E). E (Animals as Leaders; low E as a pedal). Bb (an Abasi tapping riff on the 1-5-1 low strings). F#, C, G, D and B (centres of Hamasyan's cycle pieces: 'Entertain Me' F#, 'Vardavar' C, 'The Grid' G)

content: Use the low E as a pedal and put other triads above it. Use the full range for chords that span three octaves. Take known voicings and move single notes by an octave.
parameters: Example: G major over the low E pedal. The three lowest strings (E B E) give root, fifth and octave under one finger. A chord of Allan Holdsworth's type played as a block in an interlude ('Ka$cade', about 1:41)

content: Bright Lydian arpeggios beside symmetric and 'outside' scales from jazz fusion.
parameters: Major triad with a raised fourth that slides to the fifth, over three octaves in C, with an added major seventh ('Tempting Time'). Harmonic major and the augmented scale ('Lippincott'). Harmonised diminished run ('Tooth and Claw'). Half-whole diminished scale and a C# Phrygian idea in lesson material

content: Lydian and Dorian colours, pentatonic melodies, and chromatic passing notes for a fusion sound.
parameters: A Lydian tapped arpeggios: seventh and root on string 2, third and fifth on string 1. D Dorian with chromatic passing notes. Minor pentatonic from the fifth of the key (E minor pentatonic over A minor). Sus4 arpeggio shapes. Cmaj7 shapes with two notes on a string. One tune takes a Mixolydian colour

content: The rhythm method and the low chug are the same in both. The difference is the pitch material above the chug.
parameters: Dark (Meshuggah, thall): semitone and tritone cells, minor and diminished scales, no major keys, 'cold' clean parts, high dyads a semitone apart. Bright (Plini, Arch Echo): Lydian, Dorian and major melodies over the same riffs; reviews use the words uplifting, fun, colourful, jazzy

item: Chord types of the bright style (not confirmed)
content: Standard knowledge of the style, not confirmed in a source read here.
parameters: Estimate: add9 and sus2 chords with open strings; major 7 with sharp 11; minor 9 and minor 11; stacks of fourths; triads spread over more than an octave. Roots move by thirds or by step. The last statement of a theme often goes up a whole step or a minor third

content: Armenian melody uses tetrachords joined by common notes, not scales of one octave. The riff pieces move between two modes on one centre or between two near centres.
parameters: 'Entertain Me': F# Dorian and F# harmonic minor. 'To Negate': E minor and F# minor (E Dorian, F# Phrygian) with D# and A# as colour notes. 'Kars 1': C Aeolian in the accompaniment, a chromatic mode on G in the melody (folk song 'Yaman Yar'). 'Song for Melan and Rafik': A Dorian with a turn to F# Mixolydian

content: Few chords in the riff sections: lines in octaves over a bass line. Where chords appear, they have no third or they come from the notes of the mode. A modal melody can sit over chords of a distant key.
parameters: Chords without thirds; parallel fourths and fifths. Example of a melody in C# Ionian over chords of G minor. Chord set in 'Double-Faced', section A: A minor, Esus9, Esus(maj7), F minor-major 7 over Ab, Esus over F; each chord enters on a group of five sixteenths. Solo over one pedal note (A)

item: High dissonant dyads over low riffs
content: Two notes a semitone apart on two strings, high on the neck, against the low riff. Most riff work stays on the two lowest strings.
parameters: One band tunes two upper strings a semitone apart (Ab3 and A3) for these dyads. About 90% of the playing uses the two thickest strings. Bend on fret 24 of the lowest string

content: A minor seventh chord over a bass note a fifth below its root. The same notes make a stack of fourths.
parameters: Am7/D, Cm7/F, B-flat m7/E-flat, C-sharp m13. Read as sus4 chords or as fourths (E A D G C). 32 bars AABA; 2 chords in each section; ostinato rhythm from bossa nova

content: A full piece on two chords of one mode.
parameters: B-flat m7 and E-flat 7 (i and IV of B-flat Dorian). The solo and horn parts use the B-flat blues scale. 15:41

content: One mode or one sus sound for many minutes.
parameters: E-flat sus for 13 min (Ostinato). A Phrygian (Sleeping Giant). D-flat pedal (Quasar). A minor with open structure (Hidden Shadows). The notes of the riff make a pentatonic-like set, so many chords fit above it

item: Fourths, clusters, and two keys at once
content: Chords that do not fix one key.
parameters: Comping in parallel fourths that go down, in groups of 4, later of 2 (Wandering Spirit Song). Tone clusters and rising chords at the peak of the solo (Ostinato). "wild bitonal chords" on piano (Hidden Shadows). Polychords (Quasar)

content: Thick chords are the only harmony. There are no themes and no chord progressions.
parameters: "thickly voiced" space chords; piano from rich voicings to interlocking atonal arpeggios (1964). Piano: clusters, dissonance, playing on the strings

content: Two tunes or two layers in different keys at the same time.
parameters: Two songs sung together in "polytonal counterpoint". Whole-note fourths in low horns and bowed bass over a three-note groove. Fourths that go down by semitones over a two-note bass. A three-note riff in parallel modal harmony, repeated with small changes
where: Concert recordings of the 1960s and 1970s; When Sun Comes Out

item: Harmony from lines and pentatonic sets
content: He does not write chords first. Lines must also sound right together. The comping chords come from pentatonic scales.
parameters: Comping: diatonic triads and fourths of a pentatonic scale. Solo: one pentatonic scale over several chords ("common denominator"), here B major pentatonic over C-sharp m7 and B6/9 for 16 bars. Signal chord: C-sharp 13 sharp-11

content: Chords follow by colour and voice leading, not by dominant and tonic.
parameters: Frequent types: maj7 sharp-11, sus4, slash chords, m7 flat-5. Roots move by step or by third. Standard description (Strunk 2005, Journal of Music Theory 49/2); not read in this study

content: Synthetic modes with an Indian colour, and pentatonic scales over modal arpeggios.
parameters: 16 "synthetic modes" in the score book of the band. Examples: harmonic minor; harmonic minor with an added flat 5; Phrygian dominant (B C D-sharp E F-sharp G A). Lydian dominant for the 19/8 riff, which may come from a North Indian rhythm cycle. McLaughlin studied Indian music and veena for several years; follower of Sri Chinmoy from 1970
where: The Inner Mounting Flame; Birds of Fire

item: Chords and scales of one solo
content: One scale for each chord. Pentatonic scales that leave out the third of the chord.
parameters: Key G. G7 for 3 bars; A7 in bars 4-5; D-flat maj9 in the turnaround. D minor pentatonic over G7 (9sus sound); E minor pentatonic over A7; A-flat major pentatonic over D-flat maj9; 2nd mode of A-flat melodic minor at the peak. Notes: 87.1% modal, 5.9% tonal, 7% chromatic

content: The general harmonic method of early fusion.
parameters: Slow harmonic rhythm. Pedal points, static ostinatos, or vamps with non-functional chords above. Modes of the major and melodic minor scales, symmetric scales, scales from flamenco, raga, and maqam. Even eighth notes

content: The bass melody mixes a dominant scale with chromatic notes.
parameters: Bars 5-6: C Mixolydian with a sharp fifth, and chromatic notes. Bars 7-8: chromatic pentatonic phrase. Bar 18: blues scale

content: Four dominant chords with roots that go down by thirds.
parameters: C13, A13, F13, D13. Standard lead-sheet description; not confirmed in a source during this study

content: A minor key with chromatic chords before the home chord. The melody stays simple and pentatonic.
parameters: E-flat minor; chords Cbmaj7, Gm7, Abm7, Fm7, Ebm11 (VI, iii, iv, ii, i); Gm7 goes up one semitone to the next chord; melody in E-flat minor pentatonic; Hooktheory scores: chord complexity 98, melody complexity 14

item: Two chords with two common tones
content: Two chords from different keys share two notes. The melody changes scale when the chord changes.
parameters: Dm9 to Dbmaj7; common tones F and C; D minor scale over the first chord, D-flat major over the second

content: Extended and altered chords. Each chord contains the melody note.
parameters: maj7; m9; m11; m13; minor-major 7; sus2 with sharp 11 (the sharp 11 one octave up); dominant 7 sharp 5 over another bass note; ii-V-I into a remote key; power-chord fifths over a scale bass line
where: Rabbot Ho; Lava Lamp; Dragonball Durag

item: Jazz harmony in a beat context
content: Free jazz tonality, contrasting scales, consonant and dissonant sounds together. He took piano lessons during the album to learn more chords.
parameters: Related to the music of Alice Coltrane, his great-aunt

content: Minor key or Phrygian mode. Riffs can use the tritone.
parameters: Key of one tutorial track: E minor

content: Melodic dubstep: strong chords, emotional progressions and clear vocal lines, with less bass movement. Colour bass: the mid-range bass sounds are tonal and bright.
parameters: Colour bass: name from the producer Chime; label Rushdown from 2016. Melodic dubstep: Seven Lions, Illenium
